description: Recorded provider answers for the P1-1 contract tests (test/p1/p11.test.js). Shapes follow each vendor's documented wire format; $TEXT is replaced by the answer text and $T1..$T3 by its three stream pieces. framing: sse (data lines), sse-event (event + data), sse-crlf (CRLF line ends), ndjson, eventstream (AWS binary frames, encoded by the test).
